summary: Extended /app/backend/tests/test_mcq_pipeline_v3.py with 9 new tests covering the transpile-and-execute ground-truth path plus pseudocode-section routing. 20/21 tests pass in 88s. Unit tests for _looks_like_code_output_question (4), _ground_truth_from_pseudocode_transpile (3: BEGIN/END → idx 1, non-code → None, Java a*b+3 → idx 0), _process_one_stem end-to-end with ground_truth_source='transpile_execution', and admin/mcq-stats schema all pass. All iteration-5 regression tests (11) still pass. HOWEVER, the ONE new failure is CRITICAL and blocks the pseudocode routing feature: server._generate_section_questions has DEAD CODE — the elif at line ~795 that routes stype=='pseudocode' through mcq_pool.fallback_live_verify is unreachable because the top-level elif chain at line 743 catches stype=='pseudocode' first and still calls the raw call_json(pseudocode_prompt(...)) path. Pseudocode sections for tcs-nqt, wipro-elite, cognizant-nqt, infosys-hackwithinfy R1 therefore continue to bypass the 3-stage pipeline. The unit tests prove the transpile path itself works perfectly; the wiring in server.py is broken.

critical.issue: The `elif stype == 'pseudocode':` at line 795 is UNREACHABLE — it lives inside the `else:  # mcq / topic_mcq` branch (line 756), but the outer chain at line 743 already handles stype=='pseudocode' by calling `call_json(system, pseudocode_prompt(...))` (the OLD raw-LLM path). Pseudocode sections therefore never route through mcq_pool.fallback_live_verify. Feature is effectively unimplemented despite the intent stated in the review request. Fix: DELETE lines 743-744 (the raw path) so control falls into the `else` branch and reaches line 795. Verified by the new test TestPseudocodeSectionRouting.test_generate_section_questions_pseudocode_uses_pipeline (monkeypatches call_json + fallback_live_verify; asserts fallback is called and call_json is NOT).

minor.issue: Persistent pydantic/litellm serializer UserWarnings and 'close_litellm_async_clients was never awaited' RuntimeWarning — unchanged since iterations 3-5, harmless.

rca of the issue: Refactor introduced a new branch for pseudocode inside the mcq/topic_mcq else-block (line 795) without removing the old top-level elif at line 743. Python's if/elif chain evaluates top-to-bottom, so stype=='pseudocode' always matches at line 743 and short-circuits before reaching line 795. Reproduction: monkeypatch server.call_json and mcq_pool.fallback_live_verify, invoke _generate_section_questions with section={'type':'pseudocode',...}; observe that call_json is invoked 1x and fallback_live_verify is invoked 0x (should be reversed). Mitigation: delete lines 743-744 OR replace them with a call to mcq_pool.fallback_live_verify. The functional helpers underneath (_transpile_prompt, _ground_truth_from_pseudocode_transpile, _match_stdout_to_options, _looks_like_code_output_question) are all correct and unit-tested green — the fix is a one-liner in server.py.
